description: Compare the net cost of breaking the lease vs subletting vs staying to term, ranked cheapest first with notes, risks and assumptions. Use when the user is deciding how to leave a lease. Do NOT use for the itemised break-cost breakdown alone - use estimate_break_cost.

break_fee_months.description: Early-termination (break) fee stated in the lease, in months' rent, e.g. 2. Default 0 = no break clause

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used only to label amounts, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR. Default USD

deposit.description: Security deposit held by the landlord, non-negative amount, e.g. 2200. Default 0

expected_relet_months.description: Expected months until a replacement tenant moves in, e.g. 0.5 for about two weeks. Default 1

landlord_mitigates.description: Whether the landlord must try to re-let and offset rent (duty to mitigate). Default true; false = liable for all remaining rent

monthly_rent.description: Current monthly rent as a positive number in the lease currency, e.g. 2200

months_remaining.description: Months left on the lease including the current month, positive number, e.g. 7

notice_months.description: Notice period required by the lease, in months, e.g. 2; cannot exceed months_remaining. Default 2 (capped at months_remaining) if no break fee, else 0

reletting_fee.description: Fixed re-letting/advertising/cleaning fee stated in the lease, non-negative amount, e.g. 300. Default 0

sublet_discount_pct.description: Percent below full rent a subtenant would pay, 0 to under 100, e.g. 15 for 15%. Default 15

sublet_vacancy_months.description: Months the unit sits empty before a subtenant starts paying, non-negative, e.g. 1. Default 1

name: compare_options

assumptions.description: Assumptions applied (sublet discount, vacancy, deposit handling)

currency.description: Currency code the amounts are labelled in

disclaimer.description: Informational, not-legal-advice disclaimer to show with the result

options.description: The three exit options sorted by net_cost, cheapest first

net_cost.description: Net cost of this option over the remaining lease, after crediting the deposit (capped at the option cost)

note.description: One-line explanation of how the cost arises

risks.description: Risks to check before choosing this option

title: Compare options
